title: Cross-Feature Boundaries

findings.title: Direct cross-feature imports require boundary classification
findings.smallestNextBite: Classify the highest-evidence feature pair and freeze an explicit allowed/forbidden boundary before refactoring.
findings.resolution: Six imports were already valid through @/features/auth. The single deep server import now uses the explicit @/features/auth/server entrypoint.

nextBite.title: Application Infrastructure & Runtime Armor
nextBite.reason: SO-019 is complete; runtime/infrastructure risks must be proven before refactor.

constraints: No runtime refactor is authorized by Wave 01.
Cross-feature imports must be classified before any move, facade, or shared extraction.
Existing feature identity must not be flattened into shared merely to reduce import counts.

rules: Client-safe/domain-safe Auth consumption from other features uses @/features/auth.
Cross-feature deep imports beneath either public entrypoint are forbidden.
Auth remains feature-owned; no move to shared is authorized.

closeout.verdict: The only proven cross-feature pair is classified and sealed; no additional boundary refactor is justified.
